latvia.title: Dutch Foreign Minister gets a bird's eye view of Latvia's eastern border
latvia.description: On 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, hosted Tom Berendsen, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, who was visiting Latvia for the first time.

latvia.title: Is stolen grain from Ukraine beng shipped via Latvia?
latvia.description: If the checks reveal that the relevant grains do come from Ukraine, a month will have passed and the specific cargo will have already moved on in transit. However, the PVD will have information about the carrier and the origin of the grains. "This will be a reason for making other decisions in the future at the European Union level," said Balodis.

latvia.title: Latvian government undecided on airBaltic funding
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Cabinet of Ministers (CM) backed the continuation of the financial stabilisation process for Latvia’s national airline, airBaltic, but did not yet decide on the state’s possible involvement in providing temporary funding, the Ministry of Transport (SM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Missing Latvians believed to have been in China, not Nepal
latvia.description: China has officially confirmed that all 33 missing Latvian nationals were believed to be in Tibet at the time of the recent catastrophic floods and had not crossed the border back to Nepal, Edīte Medne, Director of the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, confirmed on Wednesday.

latvia.title: WATCH LIVE: Rīga Conference Business Forum
latvia.description: Live coverage of the Business Forum on September 9th, ahead of the Rīga Conference on September 10th-11th.

latvia.title: Latvia's primary school pupil-teacher ratio close to EU average
latvia.description: According to latest Eurostat data, Latvia's pupil-to-teacher ratio in primary schools is close the European Union avergage, even though it has risen over the last decade.

latvia.title: Fuel prices not expected to fall anytime soon in Latvia
latvia.description: At the start of September, fuel prices in Latvia have once again risen above two euros per litre. Current trends suggest that fuel prices are not expected to fall or stabilise, as Ieva Ligere, head of the Latvian Fuel Retailers’ Association, said in an interview on the Latvian television programme “Morning Panorama” on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: Suspected people-smuggler from Poland caught in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, September 7th, border guards in Jēkabpils region, in cooperation with State Police officials, detained a person transporting people who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Latvia will send de-mining force to Straits of Hormuz
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 8, the Cabinet of Ministers supported a draft decision on the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in international operations in the Straits of Hormuz.

latvia.title: State Audit: Latvia has work to do in foreign labour policies
latvia.description: The State Audit Office has concluded in its audit, published on September 9, that Latvia lacks a clear approach to attracting foreign labour that is based on the needs of the labour market.

latvia.title: 'Tet' to open big data centre in Latvia
latvia.description: The telecommunications company “Tet” is set to open a new data centre in Salaspils on Wednesday, 9 September, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Warm, even hot Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Wednesday in Latvia will be warm, even hot, with summer-like weather.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia will give 100,000 euros to help Nepal
latvia.description: On 8th September, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a plan by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to provide EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the floods.

latvia.title: Latvia's education system is not top of the class
latvia.description: Latvian students' performance in science, mathematics and reading have deteriorated to a new low, but digital skills are better than the average of the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries, according to the latest edition of the important 'PISA' educational rankings.

latvia.title: Blood donors needed in Latvia
latvia.description: The National Blood Donor Centre (VADC) is calling on the public to come forward and donate blood, the centre said in a release on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvia's heating fuel supply stable, prices less so
latvia.description: Heat supply companies are preparing for the heating season and currently regard the average tariff increase as moderate. At the same time, there remains a risk that high woodchip and natural gas costs will lead to an increase in heating prices, Latvian Radio reported on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvian inflation ticked up in August
latvia.description: Latest data published by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) on September 8th show that in August 2026, compared to July 2026, the average level of consumer prices rose by 0.3 %.

latvia.title: Latvia reportedly ready for men's volleyball European Championship
latvia.description: The Latvian men's volleyball team left for Romania on Monday, where they will play group stage matches in the European Championship final tournament.

latvia.title: Ludza promenade landscaping project gets public thumbs-up
latvia.description: A public vote to decide the most significant building project of last year has ended with the Great Lake Promenade (Ezerkrasta promenāde) in Ludza, proving to be the most popular choice.

latvia.title: Riga IFF announces music video line-up
latvia.description: The Riga International Film Festival (RIGA IFF, 15–25 October) has announces the line-up for its Baltic Music Video Competition.

latvia.title: Demand for Latvian-grown watermelons increases
latvia.description: This season has been a little slower for watermelon growers in Latvia, but the harvest is generally encouraging. On some farms, the watermelons are being bought up straight from the field, without even reaching the market. Growers conclude that the number of watermelon lovers in Latvia is increasing, Latvian Television reported on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvia's labour productivity improved in second quarter
latvia.description: In the second quarter of 2026, labour productivity in the EU increased by 0.9% based on persons and by 0.8% based on hours worked, compared with the same quarter of the previous year. In the first quarter of 2026, labour productivity had increased by 0.4% based on both persons and hours worked compared with the same quarter of the previous year.

latvia.title: Numerous Foreign Ministers descending upon Rīga this week
latvia.description: What is the collective noun for Foreign Ministers? A gaggle? A conclave? A diplomacy? Whatever, on 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, will be in full-on hostess mode as she welcomes no fewer than seven fellow Foreign Ministers to Rīga.

latvia.title: Latvia and Armenia sign immigration protocol
latvia.description: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Armenia, Ararat Mirzoyan, signed a protocol on the implementation of the EU-Armenia readmission agreement.

latvia.title: Residents of explosion-damaged house in Rīga still at a loss about future
latvia.description: On 2 January this year, residents of Bauskas Street 15, Rīga, were left homeless following a gas explosion. The Latvian Television programme “Aizliegtais paņēmiens/Forbidden Method” found out what is currently happening with the building affected by the explosion and how its residents are faring.

latvia.title: Latvia plans to ban bus routes to Russia, Belarus next year
latvia.description: From 2027, it is planned to ban regular and occasional international passenger transport by coach to Russia and Belarus, as well as transit through Latvian territory to these countries. This is provided for in proposals for amendments to the Road Transport Law, prepared by the Ministry of Transport and submitted to the government for consideration.

latvia.title: Latvian public media campaign for Ukrainian soldiers continues
latvia.description: To mark Ukraine’s Independence Day, Latvian Public Media, in collaboration with the charity organisation “Ziedot.lv”, is organising a fundraising campaign entitled “In thoughts and deeds together with Ukraine”.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 7th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: National bus strike threatened for next Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: The Latvian Passenger Carriers Association (LPPA), in cooperation with passenger carriers, will organize a protest action on September 16th, during which regional passenger carriers will stop providing public transport bus services commissioned by the state for one day, reports LSM's Latvian-language service.

latvia.title: Appeal for materials about Latvia's Jewish chess pastmasters
latvia.description: The Riga Jewish Community and the Museum “Jews in Latvia” are currently preparing an exhibition dedicated to the anniversaries of famous chess players Aron Nimzowitsch (1886-1935), Aleksandr Koblenz (1916-1993), and Mikhail Tal (1936-1992), as well as to the overall contribution of Jews to the history of Latvian chess.

latvia.title: Latvian National Guard chief believes he can massively increase its numbers
latvia.description: The Commander of the Latvian National Guard, Aivars Krjukovs, stated in the LSM series "Formā!" (In shape!) – which exists to portray a consistently positive image of the armed forces – that it is realistic to expect a combined force of 50,000 National Guards and reservists in Latvia in the future, and that realising this target is only a matter of time.

latvia.title: Suspected people smuggler caught in central Latvia
latvia.description: On Saturday, September 5th, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting people who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Nearly 20,000 vacancies in Latvia
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on September 7 show that in Q2 2026 the number of vacant jobs in Latvia stood at 19.7 thousand. The private sector recorded 10.5 thousand vacant jobs and the public sector 9.2 thousand.

latvia.title: Armenian Foreign Minister Mirzoyan visits Latvia
latvia.description: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, is hosting her Armenian counterpart, Ararat Mirzoyan, who is visiting Latvia from 6th to 8th September.

latvia.title: Latvian politician, director Rihards Pīks dies
latvia.description: On Monday, 7 September, Rihards Pīks, film director and former Latvian Minister for Culture as well as Minister of Foreign Affairs, passed away at the age of 84, his wife Sarmīte Pīka has announced.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Elīna Garanča in 'Adriana Lecouvreur' at the Vienna State Opera
latvia.description: On the evening of September 5th, Latvian Radio broadcast Francesco Cilea's 1902 opera "Adriana Lecouvreur" live from the Vienna State Opera, in which Latvian star Elīna Garanča reprised her role as the villainous Princesse de Bouillon.

latvia.title: Attempt from Belarus to bog Latvia down in burden of bureaucracy
latvia.description: Latvian Television's De Facto investigative show reports on a situation in involving vast amounts of unnecessary bureaucracy, reams of paperwork, sudden inspections and shady plaintiffs in absurd legal actions that is worthy of the great Ukrainian writer Nikolai Gogol.

latvia.title: Latvian obesity rate second-highest in European Union
latvia.description: Heavyweight statistics released by Eurostat on September 4th may leave many Latvians gasping for breath. It turns out that we are the second most obese people in the European Union.

latvia.title: Next few days will be summery in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will feel like summer over the next few days, but it will become cooler and rainier again in the second half of the week.

latvia.title: Daugavpils wants to revive unfinished bridge project
latvia.description: Daugavpils City Council has revived a road overpass project that is more than ten years old. The first phase, costing 12.5 million euros, was completed in 2020, but the planned second section is still at a standstill. Although there is no funding, the local council has launched a tender to ascertain the current costs, LSM's Latgale editorial reports on September 7.

latvia.title: LSM invites youth to media training project
latvia.description: Latvian Public Media (LSM) is inviting young people to apply for the new development project “LSM Starts”, which brings together the existing Public Media programmes – the Latvian Radio 5 DJ School and the Media Academy.

latvia.title: Rīga's Mežaparks locals unhappy with trees being cut
latvia.description: Residents of the Mežaparks neighbourhood have brought a legal action against the Riga City Council’s Urban Development Department, seeking to annul the felling of 87 trees to make way for the installation of cycling infrastructure, Latvian Television reported on September 6.

latvia.title: Good apple harvest this year in Latvia
latvia.description: This year’s harvest in Latvia’s apple orchards is good, but the bulk of the work – the harvesting of late autumn and winter varieties – is still to come, growers told Latvian Television on September 6.

Vasaras saules sasmēlušies, tie ir tik gardi un sulīgi. Izrādās, tomāti iederas ne tikai sāļajos ēdienos, bet arī desertos. 220 g miltu 150 ml kefīra vai jogurta 2 olas 2 tējkarotes cepamā pulvera 10–12 ķirštomātiņu […]

latvia.title: VIDEO. Kad pasaule sagriežas kājām gaisā: zagļa neveiksmīgais mēģinājums apzagt auto beidzas ar roku dzelžiem
latvia.description: Tas, kas šķita kā ideāla “izdevības sprauga”, kādam neveiksmīgam zaglim Čīlē pārvērtās par īstu slazdu. Vīrietis mēģināja iekļūt automašīnā caur tās jumta lūku, taču jau pēc brīža viņa plānus izjauca operatīvi ieradušies policisti. Incidents fiksēts Čīles pilsētā Antofagastā, un ar novērošanas kameru kadriem sociālajos tīklos dalījies pilsētas mērs Saša Razmiličs. Video materiālā redzams, kā aizdomās […]

latvia.title: Zelenska ceļā uz Norvēģiju noticis satraucošs incidents
latvia.description: Ukrainas prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska lidmašīnai ceļā no Moldovas uz Norvēģijas karaļa Haralda bērēm Oslo gandrīz trāpījis lidrobots, trešdien paziņojis Norvēģijas premjerministrs Jūnass Gārs Stēre. “Viņa [Zelenska] reisu, kad tas Moldovā pacēlās, gandrīz trāpīja drons. Tā ir realitāte, kurā viņš dzīvo,” sabiedriskajai raidorganizācijai NRK norādīja Stēre. Zelenskis Oslo ieradās otrdienas vakarā.

latvia.title: Bijušais CSDD vadītājs Aivars Aksenoks ar sievu reģistrē mantas šķirtību – vai tas pasargā no iespējamām saistībām?
latvia.description: Pēc vērienīgās datu noplūdes Ceļu satiksmes drošības direkcijā (CSDD) sabiedrības uzmanību piesaistījis arī bijušā CSDD valdes priekšsēdētāja Aivara Aksenoka un viņa sievas lēmums reģistrēt visas mantas šķirtību. lithuania.description: System kaucyjny działa w Polsce od niemal roku i do tej pory spotkał się z mieszanym odbiorem. Konsumenci skarżą się między innymi na trudności w oddawaniu butelek. Jego zwolennicy wskazują natomiast na mniejszą ilość śmieci na ulicach. Swoje wątpliwości ma natomiast branża segregacji odpadów. - Ten system w XXI wieku, przy nowoczesnych sortowniach odpadów, jest niepotrzebny - powiedział w trakcie debaty TVN24+ Karol Wójcik z Izby Branży Komunalnej.

lithuania.title: Nemecký minister obrany obhajuje 140 miliárd na obranu. „Sme doslova v hľadáčiku Moskvy“
lithuania.description: Nemecký minister obrany tvrdí, že Moskva zvyšuje vojenské kapacity, dopĺňa zásoby a čoraz viac ohrozuje členské štáty NATO. Berlín preto plánuje výrazne navýšiť obranný rozpočet.

lithuania.title: RECENZE: Film Léčivé účinky sebeklamu zůstal spíš divadlem
lithuania.description: Podle divadelní předlohy světově proslulého francouzsko-belgického dramatika Erica-Emmanuela Schmitta Enigmatické variace napsal a natočil scenárista a režisér Adolf Zika film Léčivé účinky sebeklamu, který dnes vstupuje do kin.

lithuania.title: Polonia ia un împrumut de miliarde de dolari, pentru a cumpăra echipament militar american
lithuania.description: Statele Unite ale Americii îi acordă Poloniei un împrumut de miliarde de dolari astfel încât această țară să cumpere echipament militar american. Varșovia a semnat un acord de garantare a împrumuturilor în valoare de 4 miliarde de dolari SUA pentru a contribui la finanțarea achizițiilor de echipament militar american, în contextul în care Polonia continuă să-și consolideze forțele armate și flancul estic al NATO, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Senatoarea PNL Nicoleta Pauliuc va propune în Comisia pentru apărare maximum două mandate de 5 ani pentru șefii serviciilor
lithuania.description: Senatoarea PNL Nicoleta Pauliuc a anunțat, miercuri, că va depune nouă amendamente la proiectul de lege privind limitarea mandatelor șefilor serviciilor și structurilor de securitate inițiat de USR. Printre propuneri se numără maximum două mandate pentru aceeași persoană, cu o durată de cinci ani, evaluarea anuală în Parlament și reguli mai clare pentru numire și revocare.

lithuania.title: România și SUA vor să extindă cooperarea militară pe Flancul Estic al NATO. Noi planuri discutate la București
lithuania.description: România și Statele Unite vor să ducă mai departe cooperarea militară, într-un context de securitate tot mai complicat pe Flancul Estic al NATO. Noi forme de pregătire și proiecte comune au fost discutate la București de șeful Statului Major al Apărării, generalul Gheorghiță Vlad, cu oficiali de rang înalt ai Gărzii Naționale a SUA.

lithuania.title: Heritage Foundation: România este o ancoră a NATO la Marea Neagră. Recomandările fundației pentru administraţia Trump și Armata Română
lithuania.description: România este una dintre cele mai constante aliate ale Statelor Unite pe flancul estic al NATO, însă potenţialul economic al parteneriatului strategic rămâne în mare parte nevalorificat, investiţiile americane greenfield încetinind din cauza schimbărilor legislative repetate şi a instabilităţii coaliţiei de guvernare de la Bucureşti, se arată într-un raport publicat, marţi, de The Heritage Foundation, unul dintre cele mai influente think tank-uri conservatoare din Washington.

lithuania.title: Mai puțin de 2 din 10 liceeni fac suficientă mișcare. INSP a demarat o campanie națională pentru un stil de viață sănătos. Ce recomandă
lithuania.description: Institutul Naţional de Sănătate Publică (INSP) derulează, în lunile septembrie şi octombrie, o campanie de promovare a alimentaţiei sănătoase şi a activităţii fizice, pornind de la statistici îngrijorătoare. Cel puţin un copil de 7-9 ani din zece este obez şi mai puţin de 2 din 10 elevi de liceu ating nivelul de activitate fizică recomandat de OMS. În cazul adulţilor, sedentarismul şi alimentaţia nepotrivită pot duce la grave probleme de sănătate.

lithuania.title: Petrişor Peiu, despre rezultatele PISA: Mai rău ca noi stau doar Republica Moldova şi Bulgaria. Consecinţele sunt dramatice
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, afirmă, miercuri, după publicarea rezultatelor la testele PISA, că mai rău decât elevii din România stau doar cei din Republica Moldova şi Bulgaria, consecinţele fiind „dramatice”. „Şcoala nu poate asigura o performanţă comparabilă cu media europeană sau occidentală (OCDE) a copiilor care o urmează”, transmite senatorul, odată cu un mesaj către alegători: „Nu vă mai miraţi de calitatea sub-mediocră a liderilor politici”.

lithuania.title: Sardinia, noua „insulă a diavolului”: măsura autorităților italiene privind liderii mafioți care îi nemulțumește pe localnici
lithuania.description: Sardinia este transformată într-o „Insulă a Diavolului” prin decizia autorităților italiene de a transfera în închisoarea sa cei mai notorii șefi mafioți și teroriști, a afirmat guvernatorul acesteia, potrivit The Times.

lithuania.title: Kelemen Hunor: Senatorul Lorant Antal nu a avut mandat de la UDMR să fie în avionul Bucureşti-Mykonos. Nu avea ce căuta acolo
lithuania.description: Senatorul UDMR István-Loránt Antal nu a avut mandat de la partid să se afle în avionul pe ruta Bucureşti - Mykonos şi nu trebuia să se afle în acel avion, a declarat, marţi, preşedintele Uniunii, Kelemen Hunor, potrivit Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu spune că AUR s-a înţeles cu PSD pe subiectul şefilor de la SRR şi SRTv: „Nu am ales-o eu, ştiţi că nu mă pricep la asta”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a recunoscut că a existat o înţelegere cu parlamentarii social-democraţi pe tema şefilor de la Societăţile Române de Radio şi Televiziune, votaţi marţi de Birourile permanente reunite ale celor două Camere.

lithuania.title: Petrişor Peiu: Guvernele Ciolacu şi Bolojan au adus recesiune, inflaţie şi cea mai gravă criză economică de după aderarea ţării la UE
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, acuză guvernele Ciolacu şi Bolojan că au transformat România în „bolnavul economic al Europei” şi au împins ţara în cea mai gravă criză economică de după aderarea la Uniunea Europeană. Parlamentarul avertizează că România este prinsă în stagflaţie, cu doar trei trimestre de creştere economică din ultimele zece şi cu cea mai mare inflaţie din Europa, şi susţine că ţara nu poate fi scoasă din criză de aceiaşi oameni care au provocat-o.

lithuania.title: Lavrov susține că SUA tolerează controlul rusesc în Ucraina și renunță la ideea primirii Ucrainei în NATO
lithuania.description: Lavrov susține că SUA tolerează controlul rusesc în Ucraina și renunță la ideea primirii Ucrainei în NATO

lithuania.title: „Faceți calculul”. Avioanele NATO au decolat de urgență de 700 de ori în doi ani din cauza dronelor și avioanelor trimise de Putin
lithuania.description: NATO a mobilizat avioane de vânătoare de aproximativ 700 de ori în ultimii doi ani pentru a contracara provocările rusești, a declarat luni cel mai înalt oficial militar al Alianței.

lithuania.title: Paradoxul creditării în România. Cosmin Marinescu, viceguvernator BNR: „Mai mulți bani pentru stat, mai puțini pentru economie”
lithuania.description: România are cel mai scăzut nivel al intermedierii financiare din Uniunea Europeană: creditele acordate economiei reprezintă 40% din PIB, față de o medie europeană de 106%. Deși firmele românești sunt printre cele mai îndatorate, cea mai mare parte a finanțării lor nu vine de la băncile din țară, ci din împrumuturi în interiorul grupurilor și din amânarea plății facturilor. În același timp, împrumuturile tot mai mari contractate de stat reduc banii disponibili pentru investițiile private, avertizează viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu.

lithuania.title: Atac rusesc cu dronă asupra unui centru comercial din Sumî / Trei persoane au murit și altele au fost rănite
lithuania.description: Un atac cu o dronă rusească asupra unui centru comercial și de divertisment din orașul Sumî, în nordul Ucrainei, s-a soldat cu trei morți și două persoane rănite, potrivit guvernatorului regional, Oleh Hryhorov. Acesta a anunțat atacul într-un mesaj publicat pe Telegram, precizând că în urma loviturii a izbucnit un incendiu. O fotografie publicată de […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Peeter Kaldre: NATO's secret war
lithuania.description: It cannot be said that NATO is sitting helplessly with its hands in its lap, fearfully waiting for a Russian attack.
